fallback_decisions.why_selected_over_recent_options: Vercel’s dated announcement provides a concrete no-redeployment routing decision with stable identifiers, fallback and retention controls.
Google’s procedure supplies a reversible dual-index migration with explicit capacity costs and rollback rather than a product-only update.
Anthropic’s expansion names participating research institutions and bounded support while clearly remaining early program evidence.
Microsoft’s harness exposes a workplace governance decision across model choice, context, tools, memory and cost instead of another isolated feature.
OpenAI’s ServiceNow partnership grounds noncoding agent use in existing permissions, record boundaries and approval paths for one service task.
Oracle’s visual builder supports the edition’s sole reusable capability procedure with explicit knowledge, action, exception and test boundaries.
